name: Ninomiya
source:
A weird scientist who has a research institute outside the city. She does things her way at her own pace.

A very talented and wise woman, but she's also very lazy.

She can open a bag of chips with her feet.

"I'll do it someday~, just wait. Hey."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
